segments.source_text: The HDSP's ability to encode information via holograms has tremendous biomedical potential. It could be used to print layered skin tissue containing dermis and epidermis. It could support targeted drug delivery in hydrogel matrices. It could manufacture tissue-engineering scaffolds with gradient growth factors. These opportunities highlight the importance of preserving the full discussion instead of summarizing it away.
